name: Archery Simulator: Target Shooting
summary: Master the bow in Archery Simulator: Target Shooting, a colorful VR archery challenge built around precision, timing, and satisfying bow-and-arrow physics. Take on 50 handcrafted levels with moving targets, wind, limited arrows, timed stages, rescue missions, balloons, locks, fire, ice, lava hazards, score goals, stars, coins, trophies, and a relaxed practice mode with unlimited arrows.
